label: Tanec · Břišní minutový s hudbou (LTX)
label_en: Dance · Belly, one minute with music (LTX)
desc: Rychlejší a ostřejší varianta minutového břišního tance s jednou souvislou skladbou. Podoba tváře se mezi střihy vlní — na střihu se vrací k fotce, uvnitř klipu ujíždí.
desc_en: The faster, sharper take on the one-minute belly dance with one continuous piece of music. The facial likeness pulses — it returns to the photo at each cut and drifts within a clip.
soundtrack: she performs a belly dance, hips swaying to the rhythm. Middle-eastern percussion music with a steady hypnotic drum rhythm and a melodic flute line.
style_tail: , static camera, natural room lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed
negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted
